successors.text: the former Orange Free State: the colony 'created after Britain first occupied (1900) and then annexed (1902)'

ledger.x: 31 May 1902: the Orange Free State, already occupied since 13 March 1900, ratifies the Treaty of Vereeniging and becomes the British Orange River Colony.
31 May 1910: the colony enters the Union of South Africa as the Orange Free State Province.
